A '''repulsorlift company''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
Repulsorlift companies were comprised of two [[repulsorlift platoon]]s, and two [[line platoon]]s for a total of two hundred and twenty personnel, including the command support elements. Thirty-one repulsorlift vehicles were employed by the company; twenty-two combat vehicles, a command vehicle, and eight support vehicles. Each line platoon was assigned to a repulsorlift platoon for transport and deployment into combat.<ref name="ISB" />

A repulsorlift company could be augmented by the addition of another repulsorlift platoon and accompanying line platoon, a [[heavy weapons repulsorlift platoon]], and a [[scout platoon]].<ref name="ISB2" />

The repulsorlift vehicles accompanying the company carry infantry troopers into combat, and also provide fire support after troopers have dismounted, a claim that [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] confirmed was accurate due to being shot down over [[Tieos/Legends|Tieos]] by them.<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>
